detail: Playwright: typed 'half a thought' in composer, ran `werk add fresh --title 'Fresh idea' --parent root`; map showed it, window marker survived (no reload), composer kept the draft.

Dev server on app copy; edited src/serve/routes.ts projectList. Server output contained 'reusing the live server', same pid and port, GET /api/projects returned the edited field, then `werk add` card 'After edit' appeared with no reload.
Appended to client/main.tsx in app copy; page reloaded by itself (window marker lost), same card title, composer kept 'draft that must survive'.

Four-level chain, pane <700px (viewport 1000). Opened a..d via tiles; line read '… › Level c › Level d' with d bold; hover overlay showed Home..Level d; clicking Level c in the overlay (it covers the line) opened c with c as the bold current crumb.
Root with open/proto/decided/stale children: total, open, proto, decided counts shown and sum to total, stale ring present, no postponed count, titles name statuses; opening c-dec changed total to 2.

14 matching ids; '#werk' gave 12 rows, 'werk' first, prefix ids before contains ids, each row has dot/title/id, stale card dot data-color=stale; Down then Up returned to row 1; Enter opened /map/werk, crumb bold title, search empty.

Sent message (usage 50k tokens), picked Opus, pie aria-label recorded; stopped and restarted server, reopened page: model Opus, same pie label; asked again and the agent was launched with --resume fake-session-1.

Scripted 'No conversation found with session ID' error after restart; one send produced 'Fresh answer' from a new launch with no --resume, no 'not delivered' text, message delivered twice by werk without a second user send.

Two crashes with 3-line stderr: exactly 2 launches (one retry), pane shows 'Your message was not delivered. Send it again.' and all three error lines; resend got an answer from a launch with --resume fake-session-1.

Login error (stderr containing 'claude auth login') crashed the agent: 1 launch, no retry, both error lines shown, but the pane shows 'Fix the problem above, then send it again.' and not 'Your message was not delivered. Send it again.' (src/chat/crash-rules.ts FATAL branch).

Picked Sonnet (default shows 'Sonnet + Opus advisor'); pie blue before the first turn; during the turn the selector is disabled and keeps Sonnet; after the turn chose 'Sonnet + Opus advisor' (the option label differs from the step's 'with'; mapped as the same choice); no crash text; popover showed % and 'Clear context'; no crash text; next message answered.
The chat pane has one conversation per project and no tab strip (no tablist, no chips, no way to start a second conversation on another card). Not owned by any listed unbuilt ticket.
No tab strip or second conversation exists, so nothing to switch to.
No tabs, no chips and no red blink; a crash shows only in the single pane.
Model switch works and the next message gets a reply, but there is no tab chip to check; the chat pane has no tab strip.
Background-agent line and the 'merge it' button exist in the single chat (covered by e2e), but the tab strip that should count the tab as running/idle is absent.
